note: Components for the circuit lab: every part an electronics / electrical-engineering class uses, with pins, how to simulate it, how it should look in 3D, and what it teaches. level 1 = first weeks, 2 = core course, 3 = advanced. See knowledge/circuit-lab.md. Boards carry `runtime`: chip = the real chip emulated in the browser; server = real firmware in an emulator on our server with pins bridged over WebSocket; code = the student's code runs in the browser against a model of the board.
